description: The planar-trench collector team publishes measurements from a heat-extraction test between 2 and 12 May 2024. The own Zenodo description names PT100 and thermistor temperatures, volumetric water content and bulk electrical conductivity. Heat was extracted at about 0.7 kilowatts until operating problems; the provider reports that the compressor stopped on 11 May despite control requests. A public archive is free under CC BY 4.0. The observations can test ground and equipment response in shallow-geothermal building simulations, with model-energyplus a related building context. A caveat is that the compressor interruption changes the boundary condition and should be represented explicitly during calibration. The interval does not establish annual heating capacity or long-term soil recovery. The own metadata and archive name were checked without downloading sensor rows. This heat-extraction test is distinct from the earlier heat-injection campaigns.
